_about: The Winterwood (levels 8-20): winter wolves hunt in packs and one ranges the path, the frost troll in its cave a sub-boss, and the Winter Witch at the end of the Winterwood laying killing frost and calling her wolves.

helpers.shout: The winter wolf howls, and the pack answers through the snow!

52150.name: winter witch
52150.long_desc: The Winter Witch stands among the frozen trees, her breath hanging in the air like smoke.
52150.description: Tall and white as the snow, in a gown of frost and a cloak of winter-wolf fur, with eyes of pale blue ice. Where she walks, the Winterwood freezes deeper.

phases.message: The Winter Witch laughs, and the cold bites deeper!

abilities.name: Blizzard
abilities.telegraph: The Winter Witch raises her hands, and the snow begins to whirl!

abilities.name: Ice Lance
abilities.telegraph: The Winter Witch conjures a lance of ice!

abilities.name: Deep Freeze
abilities.telegraph: The Winter Witch begins to freeze your blood!

patrols.why: a winter wolf ranges the path

bosses.why: the Winter Witch at the end of the Winterwood

mechanics.shout: The Winter Witch whistles, and winter wolves lope out of the trees!

_fill: tools/audit/densify.py: 24 more of the zone's own ordinary creatures in its empty rooms, 0.45 hostile per walkable room as the aim
